Finger Exercise Lecture 6 Assume you are given an integer \(0 <= N <=1000\). Write a piece of Python code that uses bisection search to guess N. The code prints two lines: count: with how many guesses it took to find N, and answer: with the value of N. Hints: If the halfway value is exactly in between two integers, choose the smaller one.
